nodes.label: Dual Notification Tables Bug
nodes.description: Conflicting migrations create both 'notifications' and 'ip_notifications' tables; ProjectController writes to 'notifications' but NotificationController reads from 'ip_notifications'; stage-change notifications invisible

nodes.label: Tracker Row String-Based User Matching
nodes.description: PCM/SCM/PR stored as string names instead of user IDs; breaks RBAC, allows name collision, fails on renames; migration added FK columns but controller code unchanged

nodes.label: Document Controller Filesystem Scanning
nodes.description: Scans all files in storage on every index() call via allFiles() + size/lastModified loop; bypasses documents/document_versions tables entirely; O(n) I/O on each page load

nodes.label: Approval Controller Memory Leak
nodes.description: Loads ALL LeaveRequest and ExpenseClaim records into PHP memory, merges, sorts, slices manually; no database-level pagination; OOM risk at scale

nodes.label: SendDeadlineRemindersCommand Fatal Bug
nodes.description: References dropped string columns pcm/scm/pr; should use pcm_id/scm_id/pr_id foreign keys; silently skips all notifications (NULL returns)

nodes.label: ImportTrackerAndProjectsCommand Fatal Bug
nodes.description: Attempts to insert into dropped pcm/scm/pr string columns instead of resolved pcm_id/scm_id/pr_id; crashes with PostgreSQL column-not-found error

nodes.label: PortalController portal_invited_at Cast Bug
nodes.description: Calls toDateTimeString() on portal_invited_at which is not declared in Client $casts; returns plain string, not Carbon; fatal PHP error on portal client listing

nodes.label: PostgreSQL-Specific ~Regex Operator
nodes.description: Uses whereRaw() with PostgreSQL regex operator ~ in client code generation; breaks MySQL/SQLite test environments

nodes.label: PostgreSQL COUNT FILTER Aggregates
nodes.description: 21 queries across 5+ controllers use PostgreSQL-specific COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE condition) syntax; breaks standard SQL compatibility and SQLite local testing

nodes.label: PostgreSQL JSON ->> Operator
nodes.description: Uses whereRaw() with PostgreSQL JSON operator ->> in meta field queries; incompatible with SQLite

nodes.label: Leave Approval Logic
nodes.description: Handles leave request approval but does NOT deduct from leave balance; balances remain decorative; needs integration with LeaveBalance model

nodes.label: PayrollService Indian Salary Computation

nodes.label: Hardcoded 18% GST Tax Rate
nodes.description: Tax rate hardcoded as 18%; no CGST/SGST/IGST split per jurisdiction; exports should be 0%; needs per-client/per-service configuration

nodes.label: Invoice Sequential Code Race Condition (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously generated codes via count()+1; now uses lockForUpdate() on max-code query inside DB transaction to prevent duplicates under concurrency

nodes.label: Client Ledger Running Balance Corruption (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously wrote invoice-created ledger entry as balance=total instead of continuing from latest row; now both invoice and payment continue running balance with row locking

nodes.label: Payment Double-Submit Race Condition (FIXED)
nodes.description: recordPayment now wrapped in DB::transaction with lockForUpdate() on invoice balance; overpayment rejected with validation error instead of silently clamped

nodes.label: Employee Creation Default Password (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously defaulted passwords to 'changeme123'; now generates random 32-char password; User/Employee/LeaveBalance creation now transactional

nodes.label: Login User Enumeration (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously leaked email existence via 'account suspended' error before password check; now checks status after successful Auth::attempt

nodes.label: Negative Duration in clockOut (FIXED)
nodes.description: Carbon diff calculated with reversed arguments causing negative duration; now uses correct argument order

nodes.label: AIController Query Logging Bug (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously logged $request->query object instead of text; used env() at runtime (null after php artisan optimize); now uses input() and config()

nodes.label: Invoice Status Enum Validation (FIXED)
nodes.description: Status column previously accepted any string on update; now validates via enum rule

nodes.label: Leave to_date Validation (FIXED)
nodes.description: Previously allowed to_date before from_date; now validates with after_or_equal rule
